items.title: Tom Malone interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2023
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee responds politely but no personal relationship is described.

ctx.x: Tom was interviewed via Zoom on May 3, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and what a gas to have Tom “Bones” Malone with me today. Thank you, sir.
